voice.name: Matilda
voice.description: Soft-spoken, wondering starlight guide voice suited to gentle discoveries and bedtime.

banter.role: gentle starlight guide and shame-free demonstrator
banter.funnyHabit: Gently corrects with a real conjured object right beside a silly guess and never says 'wrong'.

foils.momo: Conjures a glowing shape or letter object whenever Momo wonders what matches.
foils.tiko: Floats beside Tiko on the Learning Cloud while Tiko counts each conjured object.

bannedBehaviours: Never hops on the ground (always floats smoothly)
Never says 'wrong' or quizzes the viewer
